services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Reel Obsession Sport Fishing offers year-round salmon vancouver island fishing charters leaving from the beautiful city of Victoria, British Columbia. Whether you are visiting for business or pleasure, Southern Vancouver Island’s mild climate makes it the perfect place for a winter fishing trip, Chinook salmon and halibut charters are available in half or full day trips. Expect to find a variety of BC salmon and halibut in the most plentiful waters on the west coast of Canada. While you’re out on the water you’ll catch a glimpse of our westcoast wildlife which may include; humpback whales, grey whales, orcas, bears, and majestic bald eagles.
